notes.title: Local Multiplayer & Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
🧑‍🤝‍🧑[b] Local Multiplayer is here![/b]
Grab a friend and face off in intense Wild West duels. In this new mode, both players must wait for the signal… and then shoot! The fastest gunslinger wins the round.

🏆[b]Global Leaderboard Added[/b]
Your reflexes matter now more than ever. Compete with players around the world and climb the leaderboard by scoring perfect draws.

[b]What's new:[/b]
🔫 Local multiplayer mode – duel your friends on the same screen.
🥇 Online leaderboard – track your best scores and aim for the top.
🎯 Minor tweaks and performance improvements.

Think you're still the fastest? [b]Prove it[/b] – alone or against a friend!
